Rounded to the **nearest tenth**, the area of $△ABC$ above is{{field-1}}.
worked_solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}ac\operatorname{sin}⁡B,
$$

where $∠B$ is between the sides of lengths $a$ and $b.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}c & =AB=4, \\ a & =BC=8, \\ m∠B & ={40}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{40}^{∘}=0.642\,788,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 8\cdot 4\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{40}^{∘} \\  & =16\cdot (0.642\,788) \\  & ≈10.3,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to the **nearest tenth**.
